title: Refusal document, version 1
description: The Refusal schema of spec/ecosystem-v1/mocks-runs-v1.openapi.yaml (components.schemas.Refusal), restated as JSON Schema so a conformance runner can validate it. 'message' first sentence says what was measured, what was refused and what to do next; 'reason_code' is the public contract key; 'allowed' lists the accepted values where a list exists.
